test_transpose_valid_dimensions: test that BMGInference generates correct DOT graphs for valid transpose operations on 2D tensors
test_transpose_invalid_dimensions: test that BMGInference raises ValueError for out-of-range dimension arguments in transpose
test_transpose_non_int_dimensions: test that BMGInference raises ValueError when transpose receives non-integer dimension arguments
test_scalar_transpose: test that transposing a scalar random variable produces a simplified DOT graph without Transpose node
test_1x1_transpose: test that transposing a 1x1 tensor of random variables produces a simplified DOT graph without Transpose node
